The '''Savareen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Savareen brandy/Legends|Savareen brandy]] beverage,<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Savareen brandy/Legends|Savareen brandy]]|system=Savareen [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> and shared its name with the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Savareen Dancer]]''<ref name="GG9" /> and the [[Savareen whist]] card game.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Savareen system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square Q-16.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
